scope: Future Windows signing infrastructure only; no published release changes

privateCandidateSignatures.app: SHA256 CMS and native SIP digest verified; RFC3161 present
privateCandidateSignatures.setup: SHA256 CMS and native SIP digest verified; RFC3161 present
privateCandidateSignatures.portable: SHA256 CMS and native SIP digest verified; RFC3161 present
privateCandidateSignatures.identity: Disposable local QA only, never a release certificate

limitations: No owner production PFX or CI signing secrets configured by this work
Self-signed certificates do not establish public Windows trust or remove SmartScreen/Unknown Publisher warnings
The custom verifier checks RFC3161 attribute presence, not independent TSA chain validation or long-term expiry semantics
No new application release, tag or real end-user version upgrade is part of this infrastructure PR
